I updated my records. The signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is now due 26 July, which replaces both 21 March and the original 14 December. If anyone asks about this deadline, I'll give them 26 July. Ilse didn't say which year, so I won't give one unless it's confirmed.

I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm. As Ilse asked, I took no other action.

A signing date counts as an operational fact under the rules, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel. The date has changed twice now, so I've noted that it's worth checking with Finance or Ilse if someone needs to rely on it.
